title: 2008 AMC 8 Problem 10
statement: The average age of the \(6\) people in Room A is \(40.\) The average age of the \(4\) people in Room B is \(25.\) If the two groups are combined, what is the average age of all the people?

solutions.text:
The sum of the ages in Room A is \[6\cdot 40 = 240.\]

The sum of the ages in Room B is \[4\cdot 25 = 100.\]

The total sum is \[240+100 = 340.\]

The average is therefore \[\dfrac{340}{10} =34.\]

Thus, the answer is D .
hints: Convert each room average into a total age.
The combined average is the combined total age divided by all \(10\) people.
